fields.description:
**Context**
Emily wants a faster way to log a sign-up directly from table view, without navigating away to the full record.

**Requirements**

* Add a quick-action button on each table view row that opens the sign-up in a pop-up/modal for logging, rather than requiring navigation to the full record page.
* Confirm which fields/actions need to be available in that pop-up vs. the full record (not specified on the call — flag for confirmation before build).

**Constraints / Dependencies**
Not discussed live on the call — sourced from Emily's own written notes, so scope/UX details need confirming with her before estimating.

**Source**
Emily's written notes, Table View > "Can we add a quick action button from the table to open up and log in pop up window." Not found in the 09/23/2026 transcript — likely from Emily's own testing separate from the live discussion.

---

**Update (Sep 29, 2026, per Kobi)**

* **Finding:** A Log Sign Up action cannot be added to the list view row dropdown. Only bulk actions at the top of the list are available, and bulk actions cannot be used for Log Sign Up or Complete Sign Up. Let the client know.
* **Follow-up:** If the client wants bulk archiving, fraud flagging, etc., scope those as separate V2 enhancements.
* **New requirement for this ticket:** Remove the actions the Sign Up list view row dropdown currently shows (Edit, Delete, Change Owner, Edit Labels) for all non-admin users. Admins keep them. Reason: avoid accidental deletion of signups from the list view.
* **Before changing:** Confirm the Log Sign Up and Complete Sign Up flows still work for non-admin users after any permission change.

---

**Update (Oct 2, 2026, per Kobi — Slack + Internal Sync)**

* **Idea (post-go-live):** A custom LWC-based list view with row-level action buttons may be possible, similar to the Redeposits prototype "My Redeposits" list view (primary button per row plus caret menu). Not for V1. V1 UX is built around the Split view.
* **Next step:** Scope and prioritize against the other post-go-live work the client wants. Tracked in [WAGR-510](https://jumpr.atlassian.net/browse/WAGR-510).
* **V1 scope for this ticket:** Quick-action button is out of V1. V1 work is the dropdown cleanup and flow check above.
* **Client comms:** Emily was told this is a standard list view limitation and that bulk actions can't run Log Sign Up or Complete Sign Up. Waiting on her reply. The custom list view option has not been shared with her yet.
* **Source:** https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BRW5L8SUA/p1790952381598149

comments.body:
Update:

* **Finding:** Log Sign Up can't be added to the Sign Up list view row dropdown. The row menu only shows the standard actions (Edit, Delete, Change Owner, Edit Labels). The custom actions already on the layout (Archive, Fraud, Complete) don't appear there, so adding Log Sign Up to the layout wouldn't either. Confirmed with Kobi. Bulk actions at the top of the list are the only option, and they can't run Log Sign Up or Complete Sign Up.
* **Client:** Emily informed via a comment in the shared Q&A doc. Bulk archive and fraud flagging can be scoped as separate V2 enhancements if needed.
* **Row actions for non-admins:** Logged in as a rep \[PSG tier: \__\_\]. Edit, Delete, Change Owner and Edit Labels do not appear in the row dropdown. The Sales Rep profile has no Sign Ups object permissions, so no change is needed for reps. The actions only show for admins.
